# `^B3` – Code 39 Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Print a Code 39 barcode with options for Mod-43 check digit, height, and interpretation line.

Reference parameters: **o, e, h, f, g**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 70](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
